contracts.source: Samsung press release: Samsung Electronics and ASML Expand Strategic Collaboration (09-08-2026)
contracts.signal: Samsung and ASML expanded their long-standing strategic partnership on High NA EUV lithography and advanced manufacturing. Samsung plans to introduce ASML's High NA EUV lithography into future DRAM high-volume manufacturing by 2028, which Samsung describes as the industry's first (company claim); High NA EUV is expected to extend the DRAM scaling roadmap with process simplification. Samsung will also join the industry initiative for a 12-inch photomask platform for High NA EUV (moving from the 6-inch format), expected to raise fab productivity, lower chipmaking costs and remove stitching constraints, and will work with industry partners on the mask technologies and infrastructure.
contracts.units: High NA EUV in Samsung DRAM high-volume manufacturing by 2028 (tool count not stated)
contracts.type: strategic collaboration / High NA EUV adoption plan
